towards unified multi modal personalizat.subject: personalization generative framework

discrete semantic tokenization for deep.subject: UIST
discrete semantic tokenization for deep.claim: UIST is a discrete semantic tokenization approach for user and item representation that quantizes dense embedding vectors into discrete tokens with shorter lengths.
discrete semantic tokenization for deep.quote: In this paper, we introduce a new semantic-token paradigm and propose a discrete semantic tokenization approach, namely UIST, for user and item representation. ... Specifically, UIST quantizes dense embedding vectors into discrete tokens with shorter lengths and employs a hierarchical mixture inference module to weigh the contribution of each user-item token pair.

discrete semantic tokenization for deep.subject: UIST
discrete semantic tokenization for deep.claim: UIST facilitates swift training and inference while maintaining a conservative memory footprint.
discrete semantic tokenization for deep.quote: UIST facilitates swift training and inference while maintaining a conservative memory footprint.

discrete semantic tokenization for deep.subject: content-encoding paradigm

discrete semantic tokenization for deep.quote: The content-encoding paradigm, which integrates user and item encoders directly into CTR models, prioritizes space over time.

discrete semantic tokenization for deep.subject: embedding-based paradigm

discrete semantic tokenization for deep.quote: In contrast, the embedding-based paradigm transforms item and user semantics into latent embeddings, subsequently caching them to optimize processing time at the expense of space.

atomovideo high fidelity image to video.subject: AtomoVideo

atomovideo high fidelity image to video.quote: In this work, we propose a high fidelity framework for image-to-video generation, named AtomoVideo.

sora a review on background technology l.subject: Sora

sora a review on background technology l.subject: Sora

promptmm multi modal knowledge distillat.subject: PromptMM
promptmm multi modal knowledge distillat.claim: PromptMM is a multi-modal knowledge distillation framework with prompt-tuning that enables adaptive quality distillation for recommenders.
promptmm multi modal knowledge distillat.quote: To tackle these problems, we propose to simplify and empower recommenders through Multi-modal Knowledge Distillation (PromptMM) with the prompt-tuning that enables adaptive quality distillation.

promptmm multi modal knowledge distillat.subject: PromptMM
promptmm multi modal knowledge distillat.claim: PromptMM conducts model compression by distilling user-item edge relationships and multi-modal node content from teacher models to reduce additional feature reduction parameters in student models.
promptmm multi modal knowledge distillat.quote: Specifically, PromptMM conducts model compression through distilling u-i edge relationship and multi-modal node content from cumbersome teachers to relieve students from the additional feature reduction parameters.

promptmm multi modal knowledge distillat.subject: soft prompt-tuning
promptmm multi modal knowledge distillat.claim: Soft prompt-tuning is introduced to bridge the semantic gap between multi-modal context and collaborative signals to empower the overfitting teacher.
promptmm multi modal knowledge distillat.quote: To bridge the semantic gap between multi-modal context and collaborative signals for empowering the overfitting teacher, soft prompt-tuning is introduced to perform student task-adaptive.

promptmm multi modal knowledge distillat.subject: disentangled multi-modal list-wise distillation
promptmm multi modal knowledge distillat.claim: A disentangled multi-modal list-wise distillation with a modality-aware re-weighting mechanism is developed to adjust the impact of inaccuracies in multimedia data.
promptmm multi modal knowledge distillat.quote: Additionally, to adjust the impact of inaccuracies in multimedia data, a disentangled multi-modal list-wise distillation is developed with modality-aware re-weighting mechanism.

promptmm multi modal knowledge distillat.subject: multi-modal encoders
promptmm multi modal knowledge distillat.claim: The introduction of multi-modal encoders with a large number of additional parameters causes overfitting given high-dimensional multi-modal features.
promptmm multi modal knowledge distillat.quote: i) The introduction of multi-modal encoders with a large number of additional parameters causes overfitting, given high-dimensional multi-modal features provided by extractors (e.g., ViT, BERT).

promptmm multi modal knowledge distillat.subject: side information

promptmm multi modal knowledge distillat.quote: ii) Side information inevitably introduces inaccuracies and redundancies, which skew the modality-interaction dependency from reflecting true user preference.

promptmm multi modal knowledge distillat.subject: PromptMM

promptmm multi modal knowledge distillat.quote: Experiments on real-world data demonstrate PromptMM's superiority over existing techniques.

disentangled graph variational auto enco.subject: DGVAE
disentangled graph variational auto enco.claim: DGVAE is a Disentangled Graph Variational Auto-Encoder proposed to enhance both model and recommendation interpretability in multimodal recommender systems.
disentangled graph variational auto enco.quote: To address this, we propose a Disentangled Graph Variational Auto-Encoder (DGVAE) that aims to enhance both model and recommendation interpretability.

disentangled graph variational auto enco.subject: DGVAE
disentangled graph variational auto enco.claim: DGVAE projects multimodal information into textual contents, such as converting images to text, by harnessing state-of-the-art multimodal pre-training technologies.
disentangled graph variational auto enco.quote: DGVAE initially projects multimodal information into textual contents, such as converting images to text, by harnessing state-of-the-art multimodal pre-training technologies.

disentangled graph variational auto enco.subject: DGVAE
disentangled graph variational auto enco.claim: DGVAE constructs a frozen item-item graph and encodes contents and interactions into two sets of disentangled representations utilizing a simplified residual graph convolutional network.
disentangled graph variational auto enco.quote: It then constructs a frozen item-item graph and encodes the contents and interactions into two sets of disentangled representations utilizing a simplified residual graph convolutional network.

disentangled graph variational auto enco.subject: DGVAE
disentangled graph variational auto enco.claim: DGVAE regularizes disentangled representations through mutual information maximization to align representations derived from user-item interactions with those learned from textual content.
disentangled graph variational auto enco.quote: DGVAE further regularizes these disentangled representations through mutual information maximization, aligning the representations derived from the interactions between users and items with those learned from textual content.

disentangled graph variational auto enco.subject: DGVAE
disentangled graph variational auto enco.claim: DGVAE significantly surpasses the performance of state-of-the-art baselines by a margin of 10.02% on three real-world datasets.
disentangled graph variational auto enco.quote: Our empirical analysis conducted on three real-world datasets demonstrates that DGVAE significantly surpasses the performance of state-of-the-art baselines by a margin of 10.02%.

disentangled graph variational auto enco.subject: current multimodal models
disentangled graph variational auto enco.claim: Current multimodal models represent users and items utilizing entangled numerical vectors, rendering them arduous to interpret.
disentangled graph variational auto enco.quote: While the incorporation of multimodal information could enhance the interpretability of these systems, current multimodal models represent users and items utilizing entangled numerical vectors, rendering them arduous to interpret.

a multi agent conversational recommender.subject: MACRS
a multi agent conversational recommender.claim: MACRS is a proposed system that contains a multi-agent act planning framework and a user feedback-aware reflection mechanism.
a multi agent conversational recommender.quote: In this paper, we propose Multi-Agent Conversational Recommender System (MACRS) which contains two essential modules.

a multi agent conversational recommender.subject: multi-agent act planning framework
a multi agent conversational recommender.claim: The multi-agent act planning framework controls dialogue flow based on four LLM-based agents and generates candidate responses to choose the most appropriate one.
a multi agent conversational recommender.quote: First, we design a multi-agent act planning framework, which can control the dialogue flow based on four LLM-based agents. This cooperative multi-agent framework will generate various candidate responses based on different dialogue acts and then choose the most appropriate response as the system response, which can help MACRS plan suitable dialogue acts.

a multi agent conversational recommender.subject: user feedback-aware reflection mechanism
a multi agent conversational recommender.claim: The user feedback-aware reflection mechanism leverages user feedback to reason errors in previous turns and adjust dialogue act planning.
a multi agent conversational recommender.quote: Second, we propose a user feedback-aware reflection mechanism which leverages user feedback to reason errors made in previous turns to adjust the dialogue act planning, and higher-level user information from implicit semantics.

a multi agent conversational recommender.subject: MACRS
a multi agent conversational recommender.claim: MACRS demonstrates an improvement in user interaction experience compared to directly using LLMs.
a multi agent conversational recommender.quote: Experimental results illustrate that MACRS demonstrates an improvement in user interaction experience compared to directly using LLMs.

a multi agent conversational recommender.subject: existing studies
a multi agent conversational recommender.claim: Existing studies have ignored the fact that user feedback in CRS can assist the system in better modeling user preferences.
a multi agent conversational recommender.quote: Furthermore, user feedback in CRS can assist the system in better modeling user preferences, which has been ignored by existing studies.

a multi agent conversational recommender.subject: LLMs
a multi agent conversational recommender.claim: Simply prompting LLMs to conduct conversational recommendation cannot address the challenges of controlling dialogue flow and utilizing user feedback.
a multi agent conversational recommender.quote: However, simply prompting LLM to conduct conversational recommendation cannot address the above two key challenges.

lightweight modality adaptation to seque.subject: Lightweight Modality Adaptation to Sequential Recommendation via Correlation Supervision
lightweight modality adaptation to seque.claim: The paper proposes a lightweight knowledge distillation solution that preserves modality information and maintains high efficiency by enhancing embedding learning through the supervision of modality correlations.
lightweight modality adaptation to seque.quote: We propose a lightweight knowledge distillation solution that preserves both merits: retaining modality information and maintaining high efficiency. Specifically, we introduce a novel method that enhances the learning of embeddings in SR through the supervision of modality correlations.

lightweight modality adaptation to seque.subject: Asynchronous learning step
lightweight modality adaptation to seque.claim: An asynchronous learning step is proposed to address modality forgetting by allowing original information to be retained longer for training the representation learning module.
lightweight modality adaptation to seque.quote: To further address the issue of modality forgetting, we propose an asynchronous learning step, allowing the original information to be retained longer for training the representation learning module.

lightweight modality adaptation to seque.subject: Lightweight Modality Adaptation to Sequential Recommendation via Correlation Supervision
lightweight modality adaptation to seque.claim: The proposed approach outperforms top baselines by 6.8% on average and is compatible with various backbone architectures.
lightweight modality adaptation to seque.quote: Our approach is compatible with various backbone architectures and outperforms the top baselines by 6.8% on average.

lightweight modality adaptation to seque.subject: Modality encoders
lightweight modality adaptation to seque.claim: Larger modality encoders, such as Large Language Models, contain richer feature sets which necessitate more fine-grained modeling to reach their full performance potential.
lightweight modality adaptation to seque.quote: Additionally, we find that larger modality encoders (e.g., Large Language Models) contain richer feature sets which necessitate more fine-grained modeling to reach their full performance potential.

lightweight modality adaptation to seque.subject: Two-stage approaches
lightweight modality adaptation to seque.claim: Two-stage approaches suffer from poor performance due to modality forgetting, where the sequential objective overshadows modality representation.
lightweight modality adaptation to seque.quote: Two-stage approaches can mitigate such concerns, but they suffer from poor performance due to modality forgetting, where the sequential objective overshadows modality representation.

magicvideo v2 multi stage high aesthetic.subject: MagicVideo-V2
magicvideo v2 multi stage high aesthetic.claim: MagicVideo-V2 integrates the text-to-image model, video motion generator, reference image embedding module and frame interpolation module into an end-to-end video generation pipeline.
magicvideo v2 multi stage high aesthetic.quote: In this work, we introduce MagicVideo-V2 that integrates the text-to-image model, video motion generator, reference image embedding module and frame interpolation module into an end-to-end video generation pipeline.

magicvideo v2 multi stage high aesthetic.subject: MagicVideo-V2
magicvideo v2 multi stage high aesthetic.claim: MagicVideo-V2 can generate an aesthetically pleasing, high-resolution video with remarkable fidelity and smoothness.

magicvideo v2 multi stage high aesthetic.subject: MagicVideo-V2

magicvideo v2 multi stage high aesthetic.quote: It demonstrates superior performance over leading Text-to-Video systems such as Runway, Pika 1.0, Morph, Moon Valley and Stable Video Diffusion model via user evaluation at large scale.

unified io 2 scaling autoregressive mult.subject: Unified-IO 2
unified io 2 scaling autoregressive mult.claim: Unified-IO 2 is the first autoregressive multi-modal model capable of understanding and generating image, text, audio, and action.
unified io 2 scaling autoregressive mult.quote: We present Unified-IO 2,the. first autoregressive multi-modal model that is capable of understanding and generating image, text, audio, and action.

unified io 2 scaling autoregressive mult.subject: Unified-IO 2
unified io 2 scaling autoregressive mult.claim: The model unifies different modalities by tokenizing inputs and outputs into a shared semantic space and processing them with a single encoder-decoder transformer model.
unified io 2 scaling autoregressive mult.quote: To unify different modalities, we tokenize inputs and outputs - images, text, audio, action, bounding boxes etc., into a shared semantic space and then process them with a single encoder-decoder transformer model.

unified io 2 scaling autoregressive mult.subject: Unified-IO 2
unified io 2 scaling autoregressive mult.claim: The model is trained from scratch on a large multimodal pre-training corpus using a multimodal mixture of denoisers objective.
unified io 2 scaling autoregressive mult.quote: We train our model from scratch on a large multimodal pre-training corpus from diverse sources with a multimodal mixture of denoisers objective.

unified io 2 scaling autoregressive mult.subject: Unified-IO 2
unified io 2 scaling autoregressive mult.claim: The model is finetuned on an ensemble of 120 datasets with prompts and augmentations to learn an expansive set of skills.
unified io 2 scaling autoregressive mult.quote: To learn an expansive set of skills, such as following multimodal instructions, we construct and. finetune on an ensemble of 120 datasets with prompts and augmentations.

unified io 2 scaling autoregressive mult.subject: Unified-IO 2
unified io 2 scaling autoregressive mult.claim: Unified-IO 2 achieves state-of-the-art performance on the GRIT benchmark and strong results in more than 35 benchmarks.
unified io 2 scaling autoregressive mult.quote: With a single unified model, Unified-io 2 achieves state-of-the-art performance on the GRIT benchmark and strong results in more than 35 benchmarks, including image generation and understanding, natural language understanding, video and audio understanding, and robotic manipulation.

parallel ranking of ads and creatives in.subject: online parallel estimation of ads and creatives ranking architecture
parallel ranking of ads and creatives in.claim: The paper proposes a novel architecture for online parallel estimation of ads and creatives ranking that enables sophisticated personalized creative modeling while reducing overall latency.
parallel ranking of ads and creatives in.quote: In this paper, we propose for the first time a novel architecture for online parallel estimation of ads and creatives ranking, as well as the corresponding offline joint optimization model. The online architecture enables sophisticated personalized creative modeling while reducing overall latency.

parallel ranking of ads and creatives in.subject: offline joint optimization model
parallel ranking of ads and creatives in.claim: The proposed offline joint model for CTR estimation allows mutual awareness and collaborative optimization between ads and creatives.
parallel ranking of ads and creatives in.quote: The offline joint model for CTR estimation allows mutual awareness and collaborative optimization between ads and creatives.

parallel ranking of ads and creatives in.subject: proposed approach

parallel ranking of ads and creatives in.quote: The results demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach in both offline evaluations and real-world advertising platforms online in terms of response time, CTR, and CPM.

parallel ranking of ads and creatives in.subject: existing methods

parallel ranking of ads and creatives in.quote: Existing methods typically perform serial ranking of ads or creatives, limiting the creative module in terms of both effectiveness and efficiency.

ziplora any subject in any style by effe.subject: ZipLoRA
ziplora any subject in any style by effe.claim: ZipLoRA is a method to cheaply and effectively merge independently trained style and subject LoRAs to achieve generation of any user-provided subject in any user-provided style.
ziplora any subject in any style by effe.quote: We propose ZipLoRA, a method to cheaply and effectively merge independently trained style and subject LoRAs in order to achieve generation of any user-provided subject in any user-provided style.

ziplora any subject in any style by effe.subject: ZipLoRA
ziplora any subject in any style by effe.claim: ZipLoRA generates compelling results with meaningful improvements over baselines in subject and style fidelity while preserving the ability to recontextualize.
ziplora any subject in any style by effe.quote: Experiments on a wide range of subject and style combinations show that ZipLoRA can generate compelling results with meaningful improvements over baselines in subject and style fidelity while preserving the ability to recontextualize.

ziplora any subject in any style by effe.subject: existing techniques
ziplora any subject in any style by effe.claim: Existing techniques for combining separate LoRAs do not reliably address the problem and often compromise either subject fidelity or style fidelity.
ziplora any subject in any style by effe.quote: While recent work explores the combination of separate LoRAs to achieve joint generation of learned styles and subjects, existing techniques do not reliably address the problem; they often compromise either subject fidelity or style fidelity.

video llava learning united visual repre.subject: Video-LLaVA
video llava learning united visual repre.claim: Video-LLaVA unifies visual representation into the language feature space to advance the foundational LLM towards a unified LVLM.
video llava learning united visual repre.quote: In this work, we unify visual representation into the language feature space to advance the foundational LLM towards a unified LVLM.

video llava learning united visual repre.subject: Video-LLaVA
video llava learning united visual repre.claim: Video-LLaVA outperforms Video-ChatGPT by 5.8%, 9.9%, 18.6%, and 10.1% on MSRVTT, MSVD, TGIF, and ActivityNet, respectively.
video llava learning united visual repre.quote: As a result, Video-LLaVA outperforms Video-ChatGPT by 5.8%, 9.9%, 18.6%, and 10.1% on MSRVTT, MSVD, TGIF, and ActivityNet, respectively.

video llava learning united visual repre.subject: Video-LLaVA
video llava learning united visual repre.claim: Video-LLaVA achieves superior performances on a broad range of 9 image benchmarks.
video llava learning united visual repre.quote: Additionally, our Video-LLaVA also achieves superior performances on a broad range of 9 image benchmarks.

video llava learning united visual repre.subject: Video-LLaVA
video llava learning united visual repre.claim: Video-LLaVA mutually benefits images and videos within a unified visual representation, outperforming models designed specifically for images or videos.
video llava learning united visual repre.quote: Notably, extensive experiments demonstrate that Video-LLaVA mutually benefits images and videos within a unified visual representation, outperforming models designed specifically for images or videos.

video llava learning united visual repre.subject: existing approaches
video llava learning united visual repre.claim: Due to the lack of unified tokenization for images and videos, namely misalignment before projection, it becomes challenging for a Large Language Model to learn multi-modal interactions from several poor projection layers.
video llava learning united visual repre.quote: However, due to the lack of unified tokenization for images and videos, namely misalignment before projection, it becomes challenging for a Large Language Model (LLM) to learn multi-modal interactions from several poor projection layers.

adapting large language models by integr.subject: LC-Rec
adapting large language models by integr.claim: LC-Rec is a new LLM-based recommendation model that integrates language and collaborative semantics to directly generate items from the entire item set without relying on candidate items.
adapting large language models by integr.quote: in this paper, we propose a new LLM-based recommendation model called LC-Rec, which can better integrate language and collaborative semantics for recommender systems. Our approach can directly generate items from the entire item set for recommendation, without relying on candidate items.

adapting large language models by integr.subject: learning-based vector quantization method with uniform semantic mapping
adapting large language models by integr.claim: The paper designs a learning-based vector quantization method with uniform semantic mapping to assign meaningful and non-conflicting IDs for items.
adapting large language models by integr.quote: For item indexing, we design a learning-based vector quantization method with uniform semantic mapping, which can assign meaningful and non-conflicting IDs (called item indices) for items.

adapting large language models by integr.subject: alignment tuning tasks

adapting large language models by integr.quote: For alignment tuning, we propose a series of specially designed tuning tasks to enhance the integration of collaborative semantics in LLMs.

adapting large language models by integr.subject: LC-Rec
adapting large language models by integr.claim: Extensive experiments demonstrate that LC-Rec outperforms a number of competitive baselines including traditional recommenders and existing LLM-based recommenders.

adapting large language models by integr.subject: LLMs

adapting large language models by integr.quote: However, there exists a large semantic gap between LLMs and recommender systems, since items to be recommended are often indexed by discrete identifiers (item ID) out of the LLM's vocabulary.

id embedding as subtle features of conte.subject: ID embeddings
id embedding as subtle features of conte.claim: ID embeddings are recognized as subtle features of content and structure in multimodal recommendation.
id embedding as subtle features of conte.quote: In this paper, we revisit the value of ID embeddings for multimodal recommendation and conduct a thorough study regarding its semantics, which we recognize as subtle features of \emph{content} and \emph{structure}.

id embedding as subtle features of conte.subject: Hierarchical attention mechanism

id embedding as subtle features of conte.quote: Specifically, we put forward a hierarchical attention mechanism to incorporate ID embeddings in modality fusing, coupled with contrastive learning, to enhance content representations.

id embedding as subtle features of conte.subject: Lightweight graph convolution network
id embedding as subtle features of conte.claim: A lightweight graph convolution network is proposed for each modality to amalgamate neighborhood and ID embeddings for improving structural representations.
id embedding as subtle features of conte.quote: Meanwhile, we propose a lightweight graph convolution network for each modality to amalgamate neighborhood and ID embeddings for improving structural representations.

id embedding as subtle features of conte.subject: Proposed method

id embedding as subtle features of conte.subject: Existing literature

id embedding as subtle features of conte.quote: However, there is a lack of a thorough analysis of the ID embeddings in terms of feature semantics in the literature.

cross modal prompts adapting large pre t.subject: DG-SCT

cross modal prompts adapting large pre t.quote: To address this challenge, this paper proposes a novel Dual-Guided Spatial-Channel-Temporal (DG-SCT) attention mechanism. This mechanism leverages audio and visual modalities as soft prompts to dynamically adjust the parameters of pre-trained models based on the current multi-modal input features.

cross modal prompts adapting large pre t.subject: DG-SCT
cross modal prompts adapting large pre t.claim: The DG-SCT module incorporates trainable cross-modal interaction layers into pre-trained audio-visual encoders to allow adaptive extraction of crucial information while preserving frozen parameters.
cross modal prompts adapting large pre t.quote: Specifically, the DG-SCT module incorporates trainable cross-modal interaction layers into pre-trained audio-visual encoders, allowing adaptive extraction of crucial information from the current modality across spatial, channel, and temporal dimensions, while preserving the frozen parameters of large-scale pre-trained models.

cross modal prompts adapting large pre t.subject: DG-SCT
cross modal prompts adapting large pre t.claim: The proposed model achieves state-of-the-art results across multiple downstream tasks, including AVE, AVVP, AVS, and AVQA.
cross modal prompts adapting large pre t.quote: Experimental evaluations demonstrate that our proposed model achieves state-of-the-art results across multiple downstream tasks, including AVE, AVVP, AVS, and AVQA.

cross modal prompts adapting large pre t.subject: DG-SCT
cross modal prompts adapting large pre t.claim: The model exhibits promising performance in challenging few-shot and zero-shot scenarios.
cross modal prompts adapting large pre t.quote: Furthermore, our model exhibits promising performance in challenging few-shot and zero-shot scenarios.

natural language generation for advertis.quote: Additionally, key challenges and directions revealed through the survey, including metric optimization, faithfulness, diversity, multimodality, and the development of benchmark datasets, are discussed.

better generalization with semantic ids.subject: Semantic IDs
better generalization with semantic ids.claim: Semantic IDs are a compact and discrete item representation learned from frozen content embeddings using RQ-VAE to capture the hierarchy of concepts in items.
better generalization with semantic ids.quote: Semantic IDs are learned from frozen content embeddings using RQ-VAE and thus can capture the hierarchy of concepts in items.

better generalization with semantic ids.subject: Semantic ID adaptation via SentencePiece
better generalization with semantic ids.claim: The authors propose adapting Semantic IDs in industry-scale ranking models by hashing sub-pieces of the Semantic-ID sequences, finding that the SentencePiece model outperforms manually crafted pieces such as N-grams.
better generalization with semantic ids.quote: We propose novel methods for adapting Semantic IDs in industry-scale ranking models, through hashing sub-pieces of of the Semantic-ID sequences. In particular, we find that the SentencePiece model [10] that is commonly used in LLM tokenization outperforms manually crafted pieces such as N-grams.

better generalization with semantic ids.subject: Content-based embeddings
better generalization with semantic ids.claim: Simply replacing ID features with content-based embeddings can cause a drop in quality due to reduced memorization capability.
better generalization with semantic ids.quote: We show that simply replacing ID features with content-based embeddings can cause a drop in quality due to reduced memorization capability.

better generalization with semantic ids.subject: Semantic IDs
better generalization with semantic ids.claim: Semantic IDs can replace the direct use of video IDs by improving the generalization ability on new and long-tail item slices without sacrificing overall model quality.
better generalization with semantic ids.quote: Our experiments demonstrate that Semantic IDs can replace the direct use of video IDs by improving the generalization ability on new and long-tail item slices without sacrificing overall model quality.

better generalization with semantic ids.subject: Randomly-hashed item ids
better generalization with semantic ids.claim: Learned representations from random hashing prevent generalization across similar items, causing problems of learning unseen and long-tail items.
better generalization with semantic ids.quote: However, the learned representations from random hashing prevents generalization across similar items, causing problems of learning unseen and long-tail items, especially when item corpus is large, power-law distributed, and evolving dynamically.

clap learning audio concepts from natura.subject: CLAP
clap learning audio concepts from natura.claim: CLAP connects language and audio by using two encoders and a contrastive learning objective to bring audio and text descriptions into a joint multimodal space.
clap learning audio concepts from natura.quote: We call our approach Contrastive Language-Audio Pretraining (CLAP), which connects language and audio by using two encoders and a contrastive learning objective, bringing audio and text descriptions into a joint multimodal space.

clap learning audio concepts from natura.subject: CLAP
clap learning audio concepts from natura.claim: CLAP establishes state-of-the-art (SoTA) in Zero-Shot performance.
clap learning audio concepts from natura.quote: CLAP establishes state-of-the-art (SoTA) in Zero-Shot performance.

clap learning audio concepts from natura.subject: CLAP
clap learning audio concepts from natura.claim: The audio encoder of CLAP achieved state-of-the-art (SoTA) in 5 tasks when evaluated in a supervised learning setup.
clap learning audio concepts from natura.quote: Also, we evaluated CLAP’s audio encoder in a supervised learning setup and achieved SoTA in 5 tasks.

clap learning audio concepts from natura.subject: CLAP
clap learning audio concepts from natura.claim: The Zero-Shot capability of CLAP removes the need for training with class labeled audio and enables flexible class prediction at inference time.
clap learning audio concepts from natura.quote: The Zero-Shot capability removes the need of training with class labeled audio, enables flexible class prediction at inference time, and generalizes well in multiple downstream tasks.

clap learning audio concepts from natura.subject: Mainstream machine listening models
clap learning audio concepts from natura.claim: Learning under restricted supervision limits the flexibility of models because they require labeled audio for training and can only predict the predefined categories.
clap learning audio concepts from natura.quote: Learning under such restricted supervision limits the flexibility of models because they require labeled audio for training and can only predict the predefined categories.

tryondiffusion a tale of two unets.subject: TryOnDiffusion
tryondiffusion a tale of two unets.claim: The paper proposes a diffusion-based architecture that unifies two UNets, referred to as Parallel-UNet, to preserve garment details and warp the garment for significant pose and body change in a single network.
tryondiffusion a tale of two unets.quote: In this paper, we propose a diffusion-based architecture that unifies two UN ets (referred to as Parallel-UNet), which allows us to preserve garment details and warp the garment for significant pose and body change in a single network.

tryondiffusion a tale of two unets.subject: Parallel-UNet
tryondiffusion a tale of two unets.claim: The garment is warped implicitly via a cross attention mechanism.
tryondiffusion a tale of two unets.quote: The key ideas behind Parallel-UNet include: 1) garment is warped implicitly via a cross attention mechanism, 2) garment warp and person blend happen as part of a unified process as opposed to a sequence of two separate tasks.

tryondiffusion a tale of two unets.subject: Parallel-UNet
tryondiffusion a tale of two unets.claim: Garment warp and person blend happen as part of a unified process as opposed to a sequence of two separate tasks.
tryondiffusion a tale of two unets.quote: The key ideas behind Parallel-UNet include: 1) garment is warped implicitly via a cross attention mechanism, 2) garment warp and person blend happen as part of a unified process as opposed to a sequence of two separate tasks.

tryondiffusion a tale of two unets.subject: TryOnDiffusion
tryondiffusion a tale of two unets.claim: TryOnDiffusion achieves state-of-the-art performance both qualitatively and quantitatively.
tryondiffusion a tale of two unets.quote: Experimental results indicate that TryOnDiffusion achieves state-of-the-art performance both qualitatively and quantitatively.

tryondiffusion a tale of two unets.subject: Previous methods
tryondiffusion a tale of two unets.claim: Previous methods either focus on garment detail preservation without effective pose and shape variation, or allow tryon with the desired shape and pose but lack garment details.
tryondiffusion a tale of two unets.quote: Previous methods either focus on garment detail preservation without effective pose and shape variation, or allow tryon with the desired shape and pose but lack garment details.

exploring adapter based transfer learnin.subject: Adapter-based TransRec
exploring adapter based transfer learnin.claim: The paper performs empirical studies on adapter-based TransRec to address whether it achieves parameter-efficient transfer learning with good performance in recommendation systems.
exploring adapter based transfer learnin.quote: To this end, we perform empirical studies to address several key sub-questions. First, we ask whether the adapter-based TransRec performs comparably to TransRec based on standard full-parameter fine-tuning?

exploring adapter based transfer learnin.subject: TransRec
exploring adapter based transfer learnin.claim: TransRec is defined as a recommender system that learns models directly from raw item modality features, such as texts and images, to enable effective and transferable recommendations.
exploring adapter based transfer learnin.quote: Meanwhile, learning recommendation models directly from raw item modality features --- e.g., texts of NLP and images of CV --- can enable effective and transferable recommender systems (called TransRec).

exploring adapter based transfer learnin.subject: Adapter-based TransRec
exploring adapter based transfer learnin.claim: The study investigates whether adapter-based TransRec performs comparably to TransRec based on standard full-parameter fine-tuning across different item modalities like textual and visual recommendation systems.
exploring adapter based transfer learnin.quote: First, we ask whether the adapter-based TransRec performs comparably to TransRec based on standard full-parameter fine-tuning? does it hold for recommendation with different item modalities, e.g., textual RS and visual RS.

exploring adapter based transfer learnin.subject: Adapter-based TransRec
exploring adapter based transfer learnin.claim: The paper benchmarks existing adapters, which are effective in NLP and CV tasks, within item recommendation tasks.
exploring adapter based transfer learnin.quote: If yes, we benchmark these existing adapters, which have been shown to be effective in NLP and CV tasks, in item recommendation tasks.

exploring adapter based transfer learnin.subject: Adapter-based TransRec
exploring adapter based transfer learnin.claim: The study examines key factors for adapter-based TransRec, specifically regarding where and how to insert adapters.
exploring adapter based transfer learnin.quote: Third, we carefully study several key factors for the adapter-based TransRec in terms of where and how to insert these adapters?

exploring adapter based transfer learnin.subject: Adapter-based TransRec
exploring adapter based transfer learnin.claim: The paper analyzes the effects of adapter-based TransRec by scaling up its source training data or scaling down its target training data.
exploring adapter based transfer learnin.quote: Finally, we look at the effects of adapter-based TransRec by either scaling up its source training data or scaling down its target training data.

text is all you need learning language r.subject: Recformer
text is all you need learning language r.claim: Recformer is a novel framework that models user preferences and item features as language representations to generalize to new items and datasets.
text is all you need learning language r.quote: In this paper, we propose to model user preferences and item features as language representations that can be generalized to new items and datasets. To this end, we present a novel framework, named Recformer, which effectively learns language representations for sequential recommendation.

text is all you need learning language r.subject: Recformer
text is all you need learning language r.claim: Recformer formulates an item as a 'sentence' by flattening item key-value attributes described by text so that an item sequence becomes a sequence of sentences.
text is all you need learning language r.quote: Specifically, we propose to formulate an item as a "sentence" (word sequence) by flattening item key-value attributes described by text so that an item sequence for a user becomes a sequence of sentences.

text is all you need learning language r.subject: Recformer
text is all you need learning language r.claim: Recformer uses a bi-directional Transformer similar to Longformer but with different embedding layers to encode item sequences.
text is all you need learning language r.quote: For encoding item sequences, we design a bi-directional Transformer similar to the model Longformer but with different embedding layers for sequential recommendation.

text is all you need learning language r.subject: Recformer
text is all you need learning language r.claim: Recformer employs novel pretraining and finetuning methods that combine language understanding and recommendation tasks for effective representation learning.
text is all you need learning language r.quote: For effective representation learning, we propose novel pretraining and finetuning methods which combine language understanding and recommendation tasks.

text is all you need learning language r.subject: Recformer
text is all you need learning language r.claim: Experiments on six datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of Recformer for sequential recommendation, especially in low-resource and cold-start settings.
text is all you need learning language r.quote: Extensive experiments conducted on six datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of Recformer for sequential recommendation, especially in low-resource and cold-start settings.

text is all you need learning language r.subject: Existing methods
text is all you need learning language r.claim: Existing methods that rely on explicit item IDs or general textual features struggle to model cold-start items or transfer knowledge to new datasets.
text is all you need learning language r.quote: While promising, these approaches still struggle to model cold-start items or transfer knowledge to new datasets.

vip5 towards multimodal foundation model.subject: VIP5
vip5 towards multimodal foundation model.claim: VIP5 is a multimodal foundation model that considers visual, textual, and personalization modalities under the P5 recommendation paradigm to unify various modalities and recommendation tasks.
vip5 towards multimodal foundation model.quote: In light of this, we propose the development of a multimodal foundation model (MFM) considering visual, textual, and personalization modalities under the P5 recommendation paradigm, thus named VIP5 (Visual P5), to unify various modalities and recommendation tasks.

vip5 towards multimodal foundation model.subject: multimodal personalized prompts
vip5 towards multimodal foundation model.claim: The authors introduce multimodal personalized prompts to accommodate multiple modalities under a shared format.
vip5 towards multimodal foundation model.quote: To achieve this, we introduce multimodal personalized prompts to accommodate multiple modalities under a shared format.

vip5 towards multimodal foundation model.subject: parameter-efficient training method
vip5 towards multimodal foundation model.claim: The proposed parameter-efficient training method involves freezing the P5 backbone and fine-tuning lightweight adapters.
vip5 towards multimodal foundation model.quote: Additionally, we propose a parameter-efficient training method for foundation models, which involves freezing the P5 backbone and fine-tuning lightweight adapters, resulting in improved recommendation performance and increased efficiency in terms of training time and memory usage.

vip5 towards multimodal foundation model.subject: parameter-efficient training method
vip5 towards multimodal foundation model.claim: The parameter-efficient training method results in improved recommendation performance and increased efficiency in terms of training time and memory usage.
vip5 towards multimodal foundation model.quote: Additionally, we propose a parameter-efficient training method for foundation models, which involves freezing the P5 backbone and fine-tuning lightweight adapters, resulting in improved recommendation performance and increased efficiency in terms of training time and memory usage.

vip5 towards multimodal foundation model.subject: Computer Vision, NLP, and Recommender Systems
vip5 towards multimodal foundation model.claim: The traditional independent development of Computer Vision, NLP, and Recommender Systems has impeded the ability for these fields to directly benefit from each other's advancements.
vip5 towards multimodal foundation model.quote: Computer Vision (CV), Natural Language Processing (NLP), and Recommender Systems (RecSys) are three prominent AI applications that have traditionally developed independently, resulting in disparate modeling and engineering methodologies. This has impeded the ability for these fields to directly benefit from each other's advancements.

once boosting content based recommendati.subject: ONCE
once boosting content based recommendati.claim: ONCE leverages both open- and closed-source LLMs to enhance content-based recommendation.
once boosting content based recommendati.quote: In this study, we explore the potential of leveraging both open- and closed-source LLMs to enhance content-based recommendation.

once boosting content based recommendati.subject: ONCE
once boosting content based recommendati.claim: With open-source LLMs, ONCE utilizes their deep layers as content encoders to enrich content representation at the embedding level.
once boosting content based recommendati.quote: With open-source LLMs, we utilize their deep layers as content encoders, enriching the representation of content at the embedding level.

once boosting content based recommendati.subject: ONCE
once boosting content based recommendati.claim: For closed-source LLMs, ONCE employs prompting techniques to enrich the training data at the token level.
once boosting content based recommendati.quote: For closed-source LLMs, we employ prompting techniques to enrich the training data at the token level.

once boosting content based recommendati.subject: ONCE
once boosting content based recommendati.claim: ONCE demonstrates a significant relative improvement of up to 19.32% compared to existing state-of-the-art recommendation models.
once boosting content based recommendati.quote: Notably, we observed a significant relative improvement of up to 19.32% compared to existing state-of-the-art recommendation models.

once boosting content based recommendati.subject: ONCE
once boosting content based recommendati.claim: There is a synergistic relationship between open- and closed-source LLMs in enhancing content-based recommendation.
once boosting content based recommendati.quote: Through comprehensive experiments, we demonstrate the high effectiveness of both types of LLMs and show the synergistic relationship between them.

imagebind one embedding space to bind th.subject: ImageBind
imagebind one embedding space to bind th.claim: ImageBind is an approach to learn a joint embedding across six different modalities: images, text, audio, depth, thermal, and IMU data.
imagebind one embedding space to bind th.quote: We present ImageBind, an approach to learn a joint embedding across six different modalities - images, text, audio, depth, thermal, and IMU data.

imagebind one embedding space to bind th.subject: ImageBind
imagebind one embedding space to bind th.claim: Only image-paired data is sufficient to bind the modalities together, making all combinations of paired data unnecessary for training.
imagebind one embedding space to bind th.quote: We show that all combinations of paired data are not necessary to train such a joint embedding, and only image-paired data is sufficient to bind the modalities together.

imagebind one embedding space to bind th.subject: ImageBind
imagebind one embedding space to bind th.claim: ImageBind extends the zero-shot capabilities of recent large scale vision-language models to new modalities by using their natural pairing with images.
imagebind one embedding space to bind th.quote: ImageBind can leverage recent large scale vision-language models, and extends their zero-shot capabilities to new modalities just by using their natural pairing with images.

imagebind one embedding space to bind th.subject: ImageBind
imagebind one embedding space to bind th.claim: ImageBind enables novel emergent applications out-of-the-box, including cross-modal retrieval, composing modalities with arithmetic, and cross-modal detection and generation.
imagebind one embedding space to bind th.quote: It enables novel emergent applications ‘out-of-the-box’ including cross-modal retrieval, composing modalities with arithmetic, cross-modal detection and generation.

imagebind one embedding space to bind th.subject: ImageBind
imagebind one embedding space to bind th.claim: The emergent capabilities of ImageBind improve with the strength of the image encoder.
imagebind one embedding space to bind th.quote: The emergent capabilities improve with the strength of the image encoder and we set a new state-of-the-art on emergent zero-shot recognition tasks across modalities, outperforming specialist supervised models.

imagebind one embedding space to bind th.subject: ImageBind
imagebind one embedding space to bind th.claim: ImageBind sets a new state-of-the-art on emergent zero-shot recognition tasks across modalities, outperforming specialist supervised models.
imagebind one embedding space to bind th.quote: The emergent capabilities improve with the strength of the image encoder and we set a new state-of-the-art on emergent zero-shot recognition tasks across modalities, outperforming specialist supervised models.

imagebind one embedding space to bind th.subject: ImageBind
imagebind one embedding space to bind th.claim: ImageBind shows strong few-shot recognition results that outperform prior work.
imagebind one embedding space to bind th.quote: Finally, we show strong few-shot recognition results outperforming prior work, and that ImageBind serves as a new way to evaluate vision models for visual and non-visual tasks.

controlled text generation with natural.subject: InstructCTG
controlled text generation with natural.claim: InstructCTG is a controlled text generation framework that incorporates different constraints by conditioning on natural language descriptions and demonstrations of the constraints.
controlled text generation with natural.quote: In this work, we present InstructCTG, a controlled text generation framework that incorporates different constraints by conditioning on natural language descriptions and demonstrations of the constraints.

controlled text generation with natural.subject: InstructCTG
controlled text generation with natural.claim: The framework extracts underlying constraints of natural texts through a combination of off-the-shelf NLP tools and simple heuristics, then verbalizes them into natural language instructions to form weakly supervised training data.
controlled text generation with natural.quote: In particular, we first extract the underlying constraints of natural texts through a combination of off-the-shelf NLP tools and simple heuristics. We then verbalize the constraints into natural language instructions to form weakly supervised training data.

controlled text generation with natural.subject: InstructCTG
controlled text generation with natural.claim: InstructCTG fine-tunes a pre-trained language model by prepending natural language descriptions of the constraints and a few demonstrations to incorporate various types of constraints.
controlled text generation with natural.quote: By prepending natural language descriptions of the constraints and a few demonstrations, we fine-tune a pre-trained language model to incorporate various types of constraints.

controlled text generation with natural.subject: InstructCTG
controlled text generation with natural.claim: Compared to existing search-based or score-based methods, InstructCTG is more flexible to different constraint types and has a much smaller impact on generation quality and speed because it does not modify the decoding procedure.
controlled text generation with natural.quote: Compared to existing search-based or score-based methods, InstructCTG is more flexible to different constraint types and has a much smaller impact on the generation quality and speed because it does not modify the decoding procedure.

controlled text generation with natural.subject: InstructCTG
controlled text generation with natural.claim: InstructCTG allows the model to adapt to new constraints without re-training through the use of few-shot task generalization and in-context learning abilities of instruction-tuned language models.
controlled text generation with natural.quote: Additionally, InstructCTG allows the model to adapt to new constraints without re-training through the use of few-shot task generalization and in-context learning abilities of instruction-tuned language models.

lamp when large language models meet per.subject: LaMP
lamp when large language models meet per.claim: LaMP is a novel benchmark for training and evaluating language models for producing personalized outputs.
lamp when large language models meet per.quote: This paper highlights the importance of personalization in large language models and introduces the LaMP benchmark -- a novel benchmark for training and evaluating language models for producing personalized outputs.

lamp when large language models meet per.subject: LaMP
lamp when large language models meet per.claim: LaMP consists of seven personalized tasks, spanning three text classification and four text generation tasks.
lamp when large language models meet per.quote: It consists of seven personalized tasks, spanning three text classification and four text generation tasks.

lamp when large language models meet per.subject: retrieval augmentation approaches
lamp when large language models meet per.claim: The authors propose two retrieval augmentation approaches that retrieve personal items from each user profile for personalizing language model outputs.
lamp when large language models meet per.quote: We additionally propose two retrieval augmentation approaches that retrieve personal items from each user profile for personalizing language model outputs.

lamp when large language models meet per.subject: retrieval models
lamp when large language models meet per.claim: The study examines various retrieval models, including term matching, semantic matching, and time-aware methods.
lamp when large language models meet per.quote: To this aim, we study various retrieval models, including term matching, semantic matching, and time-aware methods.

lamp when large language models meet per.subject: retrieval augmentation approach
lamp when large language models meet per.claim: Experiments demonstrate the efficacy of the proposed retrieval augmentation approach and highlight the impact of personalization in various natural language tasks.
lamp when large language models meet per.quote: Extensive experiments on LaMP for zero-shot and fine-tuned language models demonstrate the efficacy of the proposed retrieval augmentation approach and highlight the impact of personalization in various natural language tasks.

pbnr prompt based news recommender syste.subject: PBNR
pbnr prompt based news recommender syste.claim: PBNR treats the personalized news recommendation as a text-to-text language task and designs personalized prompts to adapt to the pre-trained language model T5.
pbnr prompt based news recommender syste.quote: The proposed model"prompt-based news recommendation"(PBNR) treats the personalized news recommendation as a text-to-text language task and designs personalized prompts to adapt to the pre-trained language model -- text-to-text transfer transformer (T5).

pbnr prompt based news recommender syste.subject: PBNR
pbnr prompt based news recommender syste.claim: PBNR is capable of making accurate recommendations by taking into account various lengths of past behaviors of different users.
pbnr prompt based news recommender syste.quote: Experimental studies using the Microsoft News dataset show that PBNR is capable of making accurate recommendations by taking into account various lengths of past behaviors of different users.

pbnr prompt based news recommender syste.subject: PBNR
pbnr prompt based news recommender syste.claim: PBNR can easily adapt to new information without changing the model architecture and the training objective.
pbnr prompt based news recommender syste.quote: PBNR can also easily adapt to new information without changing the model architecture and the training objective.

pbnr prompt based news recommender syste.subject: PBNR
pbnr prompt based news recommender syste.claim: PBNR can make recommendations based on users' specific requirements, allowing human-computer interaction in the news recommendation field.
pbnr prompt based news recommender syste.quote: Additionally, PBNR can make recommendations based on users' specific requirements, allowing human-computer interaction in the news recommendation field.

pbnr prompt based news recommender syste.subject: existing model architectures
pbnr prompt based news recommender syste.claim: Existing model architectures require adjustments if additional information is taken into account.
pbnr prompt based news recommender syste.quote: However, these existing model architectures require adjustments if additional information is taken into account.

dinov2 learning robust visual features w.subject: DINOv2
dinov2 learning robust visual features w.claim: The work shows that existing pretraining methods, especially self-supervised methods, can produce all-purpose visual features if trained on enough curated data from diverse sources.
dinov2 learning robust visual features w.quote: This work shows that existing pretraining methods, especially self-supervised methods, can produce such features if trained on enough curated data from diverse sources.

dinov2 learning robust visual features w.subject: DINOv2
dinov2 learning robust visual features w.claim: The authors propose an automatic pipeline to build a dedicated, diverse, and curated image dataset instead of uncurated data.
dinov2 learning robust visual features w.quote: In terms of data, we propose an automatic pipeline to build a dedicated, diverse, and curated image dataset instead of uncurated data, as typically done in the self-supervised literature.

dinov2 learning robust visual features w.subject: DINOv2
dinov2 learning robust visual features w.claim: The authors train a ViT model with 1B parameters and distill it into a series of smaller models.
dinov2 learning robust visual features w.quote: In terms of models, we train a ViT model (Dosovitskiy et al., 2020) with 1B parameters and distill it into a series of smaller models that surpass the best available all-purpose features, OpenCLIP (Ilharco et al., 2021) on most of the benchmarks at image and pixel levels.

dinov2 learning robust visual features w.subject: DINOv2
dinov2 learning robust visual features w.claim: The distilled smaller models surpass OpenCLIP on most of the benchmarks at image and pixel levels.
dinov2 learning robust visual features w.quote: In terms of models, we train a ViT model (Dosovitskiy et al., 2020) with 1B parameters and distill it into a series of smaller models that surpass the best available all-purpose features, OpenCLIP (Ilharco et al., 2021) on most of the benchmarks at image and pixel levels.

prompt learning for news recommendation.subject: Prompt4NR
prompt learning for news recommendation.claim: The paper proposes a Prompt Learning for News Recommendation (Prompt4NR) framework that transforms the task of predicting whether a user would click a candidate news as a cloze-style mask-prediction task.
prompt learning for news recommendation.quote: In this paper, we make the first trial of this new paradigm to develop a Prompt Learning for News Recommendation (Prompt4NR) framework, which transforms the task of predicting whether a user would click a candidate news as a cloze-style mask-prediction task.

prompt learning for news recommendation.subject: Prompt4NR
prompt learning for news recommendation.claim: The framework designs a series of prompt templates, including discrete, continuous, and hybrid templates, and constructs their corresponding answer spaces.
prompt learning for news recommendation.quote: Specifically, we design a series of prompt templates, including discrete, continuous, and hybrid templates, and construct their corresponding answer spaces to examine the proposed Prompt4NR framework.

prompt learning for news recommendation.subject: Prompt4NR
prompt learning for news recommendation.claim: The framework uses prompt ensembling to integrate predictions from multiple prompt templates.
prompt learning for news recommendation.quote: Furthermore, we use the prompt ensembling to integrate predictions from multiple prompt templates.

prompt learning for news recommendation.subject: Prompt4NR
prompt learning for news recommendation.claim: Extensive experiments on the MIND dataset validate the effectiveness of the Prompt4NR framework.
prompt learning for news recommendation.quote: Extensive experiments on the MIND dataset validate the effectiveness of our Prompt4NR with a set of new benchmark results.

prompt learning for news recommendation.subject: recent news recommendation methods
prompt learning for news recommendation.claim: Recent news recommendation methods that use PLMs with the vanilla pre-train and fine-tune paradigm have not well exploited the abundant semantic information and linguistic knowledge embedded in the pre-training process due to inconsistent task objectives.
prompt learning for news recommendation.quote: Due to the inconsistent task objective with that of PLM, we argue that their modeling paradigm has not well exploited the abundant semantic information and linguistic knowledge embedded in the pre-training process.

taggpt large language models are zero sh.subject: TagGPT
taggpt large language models are zero sh.claim: TagGPT is a fully automated system capable of tag extraction and multimodal tagging in a completely zero-shot fashion.
taggpt large language models are zero sh.quote: In this work, we propose TagGPT, a fully automated system capable of tag extraction and multimodal tagging in a completely zero-shot fashion.

taggpt large language models are zero sh.subject: TagGPT
taggpt large language models are zero sh.claim: Through elaborate prompt engineering, LLMs are able to extract and reason about proper tags given textual clues of multimodal data.
taggpt large language models are zero sh.quote: Our core insight is that, through elaborate prompt engineering, LLMs are able to extract and reason about proper tags given textual clues of multimodal data, e.g., OCR, ASR, title, etc.

taggpt large language models are zero sh.subject: TagGPT
taggpt large language models are zero sh.claim: TagGPT predicts large-scale candidate tags from raw data via prompting LLMs, which are then filtered with frequency and semantics to build a high-quality tag set.
taggpt large language models are zero sh.quote: Specifically, to automatically build a high-quality tag set that reflects user intent and interests for a specific application, TagGPT predicts large-scale candidate tags from a series of raw data via prompting LLMs, filtered with frequency and semantics.

taggpt large language models are zero sh.subject: TagGPT
taggpt large language models are zero sh.claim: TagGPT introduces two alternative options for zero-shot tagging: a generative method with late semantic matching and a selective method with early matching in prompts.
taggpt large language models are zero sh.quote: Given a new entity that needs tagging for distribution, TagGPT introduces two alternative options for zero-shot tagging, i.e., a generative method with late semantic matching with the tag set, and another selective method with early matching in prompts.

taggpt large language models are zero sh.subject: TagGPT
taggpt large language models are zero sh.claim: TagGPT is a system-level solution based on a modular framework equipped with a pre-trained LLM (GPT-3.5) and a sentence embedding model (SimCSE).
taggpt large language models are zero sh.quote: It is well noticed that TagGPT provides a system-level solution based on a modular framework equipped with a pre-trained LLM (GPT-3.5 used here) and a sentence embedding model (SimCSE used here), which can be seamlessly replaced with any more advanced one you want.

taggpt large language models are zero sh.subject: TagGPT
taggpt large language models are zero sh.claim: TagGPT demonstrates effectiveness compared to existing hashtags and off-the-shelf taggers on the Kuaishou and Food.com datasets.
taggpt large language models are zero sh.quote: We evaluate TagGPT on publicly available datasets, i.e., Kuaishou and Food.com, and demonstrate the effectiveness of TagGPT compared to existing hashtags and off-the-shelf taggers.

learning instance level representation f.subject: ECLIP
learning instance level representation f.claim: ECLIP is an instance-centric multi-modal pretraining paradigm that uses a decoder architecture with learnable instance queries to aggregate instance-level semantics.
learning instance level representation f.quote: To this end, we propose an instance-centric multi-modal pretraining paradigm called ECLIP in this work. In detail, we craft a decoder architecture that introduces a set of learnable instance queries to explicitly aggregate instance-level semantics.

learning instance level representation f.subject: ECLIP
learning instance level representation f.claim: ECLIP employs two specially configured pretext tasks to enable the model to focus on the desired product instance without relying on expensive manual annotations.
learning instance level representation f.quote: Moreover, to enable the model to focus on the desired product instance without reliance on expensive manual annotations, two specially configured pretext tasks are further proposed.

learning instance level representation f.subject: ECLIP
learning instance level representation f.claim: Pretrained on 100 million E-commerce-related data, ECLIP extracts more generic, semantic-rich, and robust representations.
learning instance level representation f.quote: Pretrained on the 100 million E-commerce-related data, ECLIP successfully extracts more generic, semantic-rich, and robust representations.

learning instance level representation f.subject: ECLIP
learning instance level representation f.claim: Without further fine-tuning, ECLIP surpasses existing methods by a large margin on a broad range of downstream tasks.

gcp graph encoder with content planning.quote: Specifically, we propose a Graph encoder with Content-Planning capability (GCP) to encode an input graph. GCP not only works as an encoder but also serves as a content-planner by using an entity-order aware topological traversal to encode a graph.

gcp graph encoder with content planning.subject: GCP
gcp graph encoder with content planning.claim: GCP captures relationships between entities in a knowledge graph and provides information regarding the proper entity order for the decoder.
gcp graph encoder with content planning.quote: This way, GCP can capture the relationships between entities in a knowledge graph as well as providing information regarding the proper entity order for the decoder.

gcp graph encoder with content planning.subject: GCP
gcp graph encoder with content planning.claim: GCP achieves improvements over state-of-the-art models by up to 3.6%, 4.1%, and 3.8% in BLEU, METEOR, and TER metrics, respectively.
gcp graph encoder with content planning.quote: Experimental results show that GCP achieves improvements over state-of-the-art models by up to 3.6%, 4.1%, and 3.8% in three common metrics BLEU, METEOR, and TER, respectively.

click through rate prediction with auto.subject: Auto-Quantized Contrastive Learning (AQCL)
click through rate prediction with auto.claim: The paper proposes an Auto-Quantized Contrastive Learning (AQCL) loss to regularize the model for CTR prediction.
click through rate prediction with auto.quote: We consider this problem as an automatic identification about whether the user behaviors are rich enough to capture the interests for prediction, and propose an Auto-Quantized Contrastive Learning (AQCL) loss to regularize the model.

click through rate prediction with auto.subject: Auto-Quantized Contrastive Learning (AQCL)
click through rate prediction with auto.claim: AQCL explores both instance-instance and instance-cluster similarity to robustify the latent representation.
