click through rate prediction with auto.subject: Auto-Quantized Contrastive Learning (AQCL)
click through rate prediction with auto.claim: The proposed framework is agnostic to different model architectures and can be trained in an end-to-end fashion.
click through rate prediction with auto.quote: The proposed framework is agnostic to different model architectures and can be trained in an end-to-end fashion.

click through rate prediction with auto.subject: Auto-Quantized Contrastive Learning (AQCL)
click through rate prediction with auto.claim: Extensive results show that the proposed method consistently improves the current state-of-the-art CTR models.
click through rate prediction with auto.quote: Extensive results show that it consistently improves the current state-of-the-art CTR models.

why do we click visual impression aware.subject: visual-semantic modeling
why do we click visual impression aware.claim: The authors propose to capture visual impression information with visual-semantic modeling for news recommendation.
why do we click visual impression aware.quote: we propose to capture such visual impression information with visual-semantic modeling for news recommendation.

why do we click visual impression aware.subject: local impression modeling module
why do we click visual impression aware.claim: The local impression modeling module is devised to simultaneously attend to decomposed details in the impression when understanding the semantic meaning of news title.
why do we click visual impression aware.quote: Specifically, we devise the local impression modeling module to simultaneously attend to decomposed details in the impression when understanding the semantic meaning of news title, which could explicitly get close to the process of users reading news.

why do we click visual impression aware.subject: visual impression
why do we click visual impression aware.claim: Visual impression is defined as the region of the news displayed on the user interface of a news application, which delivers both content and layout information to users.
why do we click visual impression aware.quote: In this paper, we refer to visual impression as the region of the news displayed on the user interface of a news application, which delivers both content and layout information to users.

why do we click visual impression aware.subject: MIND dataset
why do we click visual impression aware.claim: The text-dominated news recommendation dataset MIND is extended by adding snapshot impression images to accommodate the research of visual impression-aware news recommendation.
why do we click visual impression aware.quote: To accommodate the research of visual impression-aware news recommendation, we extend the text-dominated news recommendation dataset MIND by adding snapshot impression images and will release it to nourish the research field.

why do we click visual impression aware.subject: proposed method
why do we click visual impression aware.claim: Extensive comparisons with state-of-the-art news recommenders demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method and the promising capability of modeling visual impressions for content-based recommenders.
why do we click visual impression aware.quote: Extensive comparisons with the state-of-the-art news recommenders along with the in-depth analyses demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method and the promising capability of modeling visual impressions for the content-based recommenders.

learning to prompt for vision language m.subject: CoOp
learning to prompt for vision language m.claim: CoOp models a prompt’s context words with learnable vectors while the entire pre-trained parameters are kept fixed.
learning to prompt for vision language m.quote: Concretely, CoOp models a prompt’s context words with learnable vectors while the entire pre-trained parameters are kept fixed.

learning to prompt for vision language m.subject: CoOp
learning to prompt for vision language m.claim: CoOp requires as few as one or two shots to beat hand-crafted prompts with a decent margin.
learning to prompt for vision language m.quote: Through extensive experiments on 11 datasets, we demonstrate that CoOp requires as few as one or two shots to beat hand-crafted prompts with a decent margin and is able to gain significant improvements over prompt engineering with more shots, e.g., with 16 shots the average gain is around 15% (with the highest reaching over 45%).

learning to prompt for vision language m.subject: CoOp
learning to prompt for vision language m.claim: With 16 shots, CoOp gains an average improvement of around 15% over prompt engineering, with the highest gain reaching over 45%.
learning to prompt for vision language m.quote: Through extensive experiments on 11 datasets, we demonstrate that CoOp requires as few as one or two shots to beat hand-crafted prompts with a decent margin and is able to gain significant improvements over prompt engineering with more shots, e.g., with 16 shots the average gain is around 15% (with the highest reaching over 45%).

learning to prompt for vision language m.subject: CoOp
learning to prompt for vision language m.claim: CoOp achieves superb domain generalization performance compared with the zero-shot model using hand-crafted prompts.
learning to prompt for vision language m.quote: Despite being a learning-based approach, CoOp achieves superb domain generalization performance compared with the zero-shot model using hand-crafted prompts.

learning to prompt for vision language m.subject: prompt engineering
learning to prompt for vision language m.claim: Prompt engineering requires domain expertise and is extremely time-consuming because a slight change in wording could have a huge impact on performance.
learning to prompt for vision language m.quote: In this work, we show that a major challenge for deploying such models in practice is prompt engineering, which requires domain expertise and is extremely time-consuming—one needs to spend a significant amount of time on words tuning since a slight change in wording could have a huge impact on performance.

knowledge perceived multi modal pretrain.subject: K3M
knowledge perceived multi modal pretrain.claim: K3M is a novel method that introduces knowledge modality in multi-modal pretraining to correct the noise and supplement the missing of image and text modalities.
knowledge perceived multi modal pretrain.quote: To this end, we propose a novel method, K3M, which introduces knowledge modality in multi-modal pretraining to correct the noise and supplement the missing of image and text modalities.

knowledge perceived multi modal pretrain.subject: K3M
knowledge perceived multi modal pretrain.claim: K3M is pretrained with three pretraining tasks, including masked object modeling (MOM), masked language modeling (MLM), and link prediction modeling (LPM).
knowledge perceived multi modal pretrain.quote: We pretrain K3M with three pretraining tasks, including masked object modeling (MOM), masked language modeling (MLM), and link prediction modeling (LPM).

knowledge perceived multi modal pretrain.subject: K3M
knowledge perceived multi modal pretrain.claim: K3M achieves significant improvements in performances than the baseline and state-of-the-art methods when modality-noise or modality-missing exists.
knowledge perceived multi modal pretrain.quote: Experimental results on a real-world E-commerce dataset and a series of product-based downstream tasks demonstrate that K3M achieves significant improvements in performances than the baseline and state-of-the-art methods when modality-noise or modality-missing exists.

knowledge perceived multi modal pretrain.subject: Current multi-modal pretraining methods
knowledge perceived multi modal pretrain.claim: Current multi-modal pretraining methods proposed for image and text modalities lack robustness in the face of modality-missing and modality-noise.
knowledge perceived multi modal pretrain.quote: Current multi-modal pretraining methods proposed for image and text modalities lack robustness in the face of modality-missing and modality-noise, which are two pervasive problems of multi-modal product data in real E-commerce scenarios.

semi a sequential multi modal informatio.subject: SEMI
semi a sequential multi modal informatio.claim: SEMI is a sequential multi-modal information transfer network that utilizes product-domain user behaviors to assist micro-video recommendations.
semi a sequential multi modal informatio.quote: To address this problem, we design a sequential multi-modal information transfer network (SEMI), which utilizes product-domain user behaviors to assist micro-video recommendations.

semi a sequential multi modal informatio.subject: CCL
semi a sequential multi modal informatio.claim: CCL is a cross-domain contrastive learning algorithm proposed to pre-train sequence encoders for modeling users' sequential behaviors in the micro-video and product domains.
semi a sequential multi modal informatio.quote: Moreover, we also propose a cross-domain contrastive learning (CCL) algorithm to pre-train sequence encoders for modeling users' sequential behaviors in these two domains.

semi a sequential multi modal informatio.subject: SEMI
semi a sequential multi modal informatio.claim: The proposed method achieves significant improvements over state-of-the-art recommendation methods in extensive experiments on a large-scale dataset from Taobao.
semi a sequential multi modal informatio.quote: Experimental results show that the proposed method achieves significant improvements over state-of-the-art recommendation methods.

semi a sequential multi modal informatio.subject: SEMI
semi a sequential multi modal informatio.claim: Online A/B testing results on Taobao demonstrate the practical value of the proposed method.
semi a sequential multi modal informatio.quote: Moreover, the proposed method has also been deployed on Taobao, and the online A/B testing results further demonstrate its practical value.

semi a sequential multi modal informatio.subject: Existing micro-video recommendation methods
semi a sequential multi modal informatio.claim: Existing micro-video recommendation methods ignore users' purchasing intentions in the e-commerce environment, leading to unsatisfied recommendation performances.
semi a sequential multi modal informatio.quote: Existing micro-video recommendation methods only focus on users' browsing behaviors on micro-videos, but ignore their purchasing intentions in the e-commerce environment. Thus, they usually achieve unsatisfied e-commerce micro-video recommendation performances.

unbert user news matching bert for news.subject: UNBERT
unbert user news matching bert for news.claim: UNBERT is a BERT-based user-news matching model that leverages pre-trained language knowledge and captures multi-grained matching signals at both word-level and news-level.
unbert user news matching bert for news.quote: In this paper, we explore the use of the successful BERT pre-training technique in NLP for news recommendation and propose a BERT-based user-news matching model, called UNBERT. In contrast to existing research, our UNBERT model not only leverages the pre-trained model with rich language knowledge to enhance textual representation, but also captures multi-grained user-news matching signals at both

unbert user news matching bert for news.subject: UNBERT
unbert user news matching bert for news.claim: Experiments on the Microsoft News Dataset (MIND) demonstrate that UNBERT constantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods.
unbert user news matching bert for news.quote: Extensive experiments on the Microsoft News Dataset (MIND) demonstrate that our approach constantly outperforms the state-of-the-art methods.

unbert user news matching bert for news.subject: existing recommendation methods
unbert user news matching bert for news.claim: Existing recommendation methods merely learn textual representations from in-domain news data, which limits their generalization ability to new news in cold-start scenarios.
unbert user news matching bert for news.quote: However, existing recommendation methods merely learn textual representations from in-domain news data, which limits their generalization ability to new news that are common in cold-start scenarios.

unbert user news matching bert for news.subject: existing recommendation methods
unbert user news matching bert for news.claim: Many existing methods represent each user by aggregating historically browsed news into a single vector, which may lose low-level matching signals.
unbert user news matching bert for news.quote: Meanwhile, many of these methods represent each user by aggregating the historically browsed news into a single vector and then compute the matching score with the candidate news vector, which may lose the low-level matching signals.

content driven music recommendation evol.subject: onion model
content driven music recommendation evol.claim: The authors propose an onion model comprising five layers corresponding to categories of music content: signal, embedded metadata, expert-generated content, user-generated content, and derivative content.
content driven music recommendation evol.quote: Based on a thorough literature analysis, we first propose an onion model comprising five layers, each of which corresponds to a category of music content we identified: signal, embedded metadata, expert-generated content, user-generated content, and derivative content.

content driven music recommendation evol.subject: content-driven models
content driven music recommendation evol.claim: Music recommendation models that leverage collaborative and content data, referred to as content-driven models, have been replacing pure CF or CB models in recent years.
content driven music recommendation evol.quote: In the past years, music recommendation models that leverage collaborative and content data -- which we refer to as content-driven models -- have been replacing pure CF or CB models.

content driven music recommendation evol.subject: content-driven music recommendation
content driven music recommendation evol.claim: The field faces persisting grand challenges that are still waiting to be solved in future research endeavors.
content driven music recommendation evol.quote: Finally, we provide our personal selection of the persisting grand challenges which are still waiting to be solved in future research endeavors.

content driven music recommendation evol.subject: content-driven music recommendation
content driven music recommendation evol.claim: Six overarching challenges identified include increasing recommendation diversity and novelty, providing transparency and explanations, accomplishing context-awareness, recommending sequences of music, improving scalability and efficiency, and alleviating cold start.
content driven music recommendation evol.quote: Second, we identify six overarching challenges, according to which we organize our main discussion: increasing recommendation diversity and novelty, providing transparency and explanations, accomplishing context-awareness, recommending sequences of music, improving scalability and efficiency, and alleviating cold start.

contrastive learning for cold start reco.subject: CLCRec
contrastive learning for cold start reco.claim: CLCRec is a Contrastive Learning-based Cold-start Recommendation framework consisting of contrastive pair organization, contrastive embedding, and contrastive optimization modules.
contrastive learning for cold start reco.quote: we devise a new objective function founded upon contrastive learning and develop a simple yet efficient Contrastive Learning-based Cold-start Recommendation framework (CLCRec). In particular, CLCRec consists of three components: contrastive pair organization, contrastive embedding, and contrastive optimization modules.

contrastive learning for cold start reco.subject: CLCRec
contrastive learning for cold start reco.claim: CLCRec achieves significant improvements over state-of-the-art approaches in both warm- and cold-start scenarios.
contrastive learning for cold start reco.quote: Through extensive experiments on four publicly accessible datasets, we observe that CLCRec achieves significant improvements over state-of-the-art approaches in both warm- and cold-start scenarios.

contrastive learning for cold start reco.subject: existing studies incorporating side information
contrastive learning for cold start reco.claim: Existing works that incorporate side information into the CF scheme less explore the mutual dependencies between content features and collaborative representations and lack sufficient theoretical supports.
contrastive learning for cold start reco.quote: However, we argue that these works less explore the mutual dependencies between content features and collaborative representations and lack sufficient theoretical supports, thus resulting in unsatisfactory performance on cold-start recommendation.

contrastive learning for cold start reco.subject: CLCRec
contrastive learning for cold start reco.claim: The representation learning in CLCRec is theoretically lower-bounded by the integration of mutual information between collaborative embeddings of users and items, and mutual information between collaborative embeddings and feature representations of items.
contrastive learning for cold start reco.quote: Specifically, the representation learning is theoretically lower-bounded by the integration of two terms: mutual information between collaborative embeddings of users and items, and mutual information between collaborative embeddings and feature representations of items.

sliding spectrum decomposition for diver.subject: sliding spectrum decomposition (SSD)
sliding spectrum decomposition for diver.claim: The authors propose a method called sliding spectrum decomposition (SSD) that captures users' perception of diversity in browsing a long item sequence.
sliding spectrum decomposition for diver.quote: We derive a method calledsliding spectrum decomposition (SSD) that captures users' perception of diversity in browsing a long item sequence.

sliding spectrum decomposition for diver.subject: item embedding method
sliding spectrum decomposition for diver.claim: The paper shares experiences in designing and implementing a suitable item embedding method for accurate similarity measurement under long tail effect.
sliding spectrum decomposition for diver.quote: We also share our experiences in designing and implementing a suitable item embedding method for accurate similarity measurement under long tail effect.

sliding spectrum decomposition for diver.subject: sliding spectrum decomposition (SSD)
sliding spectrum decomposition for diver.claim: The method is fully implemented and deployed in Xiaohongshu App's production recommender system that serves the main Explore Feed product for tens of millions of users every day.
sliding spectrum decomposition for diver.quote: Combined together, they are now fully implemented and deployed in Xiaohongshu App's production recommender system that serves the main Explore Feed product for tens of millions of users every day.

sliding spectrum decomposition for diver.subject: sliding spectrum decomposition (SSD)
sliding spectrum decomposition for diver.claim: The effectiveness and efficiency of the method are demonstrated through theoretical analysis, offline experiments and online A/B tests.
sliding spectrum decomposition for diver.quote: We demonstrate the effectiveness and efficiency of the method through theoretical analysis, offline experiments and online A/B tests.

entangled bidirectional encoder to autor.subject: E-BART4Rec
entangled bidirectional encoder to autor.claim: E-BART4Rec is a novel sequential recommendation model that entangles a bidirectional encoder and an auto-regressive decoder with noisy transformations for user interaction.
entangled bidirectional encoder to autor.quote: In this paper, we present a novel sequential recommendation model, Entangled BART for Recommendation (E-BART4Rec) that entangles bidirectional encoder and auto-regressive decoder with noisy transformations for user interaction.

entangled bidirectional encoder to autor.subject: E-BART4Rec
entangled bidirectional encoder to autor.claim: E-BART4Rec dynamically integrates the output of the bidirectional encoder and auto-regressive decoder based on a gating mechanism that calculates the importance of each output.
entangled bidirectional encoder to autor.quote: Unlike BART, where the final output only depends on its output of the decoder, E-BART4Rec dynamically integrates the output of the bidirectional encoder and auto-regressive decoder based on a gating mechanism that calculates the importance of each output.

entangled bidirectional encoder to autor.subject: E-BART4Rec
entangled bidirectional encoder to autor.claim: The model employs noisy transformations such as item deletion, item cropping, item reverse, and item infilling to the input of the encoder to imitate real users' behaviors.
entangled bidirectional encoder to autor.quote: We also employ noisy transformation that imitates the real users' behaviors, such as item deletion, item cropping, item reverse, and item infilling, to the input of the encoder.

entangled bidirectional encoder to autor.subject: E-BART4Rec
entangled bidirectional encoder to autor.claim: Extensive experiments on widely used real-world datasets demonstrate that the models significantly outperform the baselines.
entangled bidirectional encoder to autor.quote: Extensive experiments on widely used real-world datasets demonstrate that our models significantly outperform the baselines.

entangled bidirectional encoder to autor.subject: BERT
entangled bidirectional encoder to autor.claim: The training strategy of the bidirectional model does not fit well to the inference stage in sequential recommendation which generally proceeds in a left-to-right way.
entangled bidirectional encoder to autor.quote: Although the bidirectional model effectively captures dynamics from user interaction, its training strategy does not fit well to the inference stage in sequential recommendation which generally proceeds in a left-to-right way.

entangled bidirectional encoder to autor.subject: BART
entangled bidirectional encoder to autor.claim: Direct usage of BART for recommendation systems is challenging due to its model property and domain difference, as its noising transformation techniques are originally developed for text sequences.
entangled bidirectional encoder to autor.quote: However, direct usage of BART for recommendation system is challenging due to its model property and domain difference. BART is an auto-regressive generative model, and its noising transformation techniques are originally developed for text sequence.

audioclip extending clip to image text a.subject: AudioCLIP
audioclip extending clip to image text a.claim: AudioCLIP is an extension of the CLIP model that handles audio in addition to text and images.
audioclip extending clip to image text a.quote: We present AudioCLIP – an extension of the CLIP model that handles audio in addition to text and images.

audioclip extending clip to image text a.subject: AudioCLIP
audioclip extending clip to image text a.claim: The model incorporates the ESResNeXt audio-model into the CLIP framework to enable multimodal classification while keeping zero-shot capabilities.
audioclip extending clip to image text a.quote: Utilizing the AudioSet dataset, our proposed model incorporates the ESResNeXt audio-model into the CLIP framework, thus enabling it to perform multimodal classification and keeping CLIP’s zero-shot capabilities.

audioclip extending clip to image text a.subject: AudioCLIP
audioclip extending clip to image text a.claim: AudioCLIP achieves new state-of-the-art results in the Environmental Sound Classification task with accuracies of 97.15% on ESC-50 and 90.07% on UrbanSound8K.
audioclip extending clip to image text a.quote: AudioCLIP achieves new state-of-the-art results in the Environmental Sound Classification (ESC) task and out-performs others by reaching accuracies of 97.15 % on ESC-50 and 90.07 % on UrbanSound8K.

audioclip extending clip to image text a.subject: AudioCLIP
audioclip extending clip to image text a.claim: AudioCLIP sets new baselines in the zero-shot ESC task on ESC-50 and UrbanSound8K with accuracies of 69.40% and 68.78%, respectively.
audioclip extending clip to image text a.quote: Further, it sets new baselines in the zero-shot ESC-task on the same datasets (69.40 % and 68.78 %, respectively).

musicbert symbolic music understanding w.subject: MusicBERT
musicbert symbolic music understanding w.claim: MusicBERT is a large-scale pre-trained model for music understanding developed in this paper.
musicbert symbolic music understanding w.quote: in this paper, we develop MusicBERT, a large-scale pre-trained model for music understanding.

musicbert symbolic music understanding w.subject: OctupleMIDI encoding
musicbert symbolic music understanding w.claim: OctupleMIDI encoding is a mechanism designed to enhance pre-training with symbolic music data.
musicbert symbolic music understanding w.quote: Therefore, we design several mechanisms, including OctupleMIDI encoding and bar-level masking strategy, to enhance pre-training with symbolic music data.

musicbert symbolic music understanding w.subject: bar-level masking strategy
musicbert symbolic music understanding w.claim: Bar-level masking strategy is a mechanism designed to enhance pre-training with symbolic music data.
musicbert symbolic music understanding w.quote: Therefore, we design several mechanisms, including OctupleMIDI encoding and bar-level masking strategy, to enhance pre-training with symbolic music data.

musicbert symbolic music understanding w.subject: MusicBERT
musicbert symbolic music understanding w.claim: Experiments demonstrate the advantages of MusicBERT on four music understanding tasks, including melody completion, accompaniment suggestion, genre classification, and style classification.
musicbert symbolic music understanding w.quote: Experiments demonstrate the advantages of MusicBERT on four music understanding tasks, including melody completion, accompaniment suggestion, genre classification, and style classification.

musicbert symbolic music understanding w.subject: OctupleMIDI encoding
musicbert symbolic music understanding w.claim: Ablation studies verify the effectiveness of the OctupleMIDI encoding design in MusicBERT.
musicbert symbolic music understanding w.quote: Ablation studies also verify the effectiveness of our designs of OctupleMIDI encoding and bar-level masking strategy in MusicBERT.

musicbert symbolic music understanding w.subject: bar-level masking strategy
musicbert symbolic music understanding w.claim: Ablation studies verify the effectiveness of the bar-level masking strategy design in MusicBERT.
musicbert symbolic music understanding w.quote: Ablation studies also verify the effectiveness of our designs of OctupleMIDI encoding and bar-level masking strategy in MusicBERT.

musicbert symbolic music understanding w.subject: symbolic music representation learning
musicbert symbolic music understanding w.claim: The lack of training data hinders representation learning for symbolic music understanding applications.
musicbert symbolic music understanding w.quote: While good music representations are beneficial for these applications, the lack of training data hinders representation learning.

u bert pre training user representations.subject: U-BERT
u bert pre training user representations.claim: U-BERT is a novel pre-training and fine-tuning based approach customized for recommendation that utilizes different frameworks in pre-training and fine-tuning.
u bert pre training user representations.quote: Inspired by the recent success of BERT in NLP, we propose a novel pre-training and fine-tuning based approach U-BERT. Different from typical BERT applications, U-BERT is customized for recommendation and utilizes different frameworks in pre-training and fine-tuning.

u bert pre training user representations.subject: U-BERT
u bert pre training user representations.claim: In the pre-training stage, U-BERT focuses on content-rich domains and introduces a user encoder and a review encoder to model users' behaviors.
u bert pre training user representations.quote: In pre-training, U-BERT focuses on content-rich domains and introduces a user encoder and a review encoder to model users' behaviors.

u bert pre training user representations.subject: U-BERT
u bert pre training user representations.claim: In the fine-tuning stage, U-BERT focuses on target content-insufficient domains and introduces an item encoder to model item representations.
u bert pre training user representations.quote: In fine-tuning, U-BERT focuses on the target content-insufficient domains. In addition to the user and review encoders inherited from the pre-training stage, U-BERT further introduces an item encoder to model item representations.

u bert pre training user representations.subject: U-BERT
u bert pre training user representations.claim: U-BERT proposes a review co-matching layer to capture more semantic interactions between the reviews of the user and item.
u bert pre training user representations.quote: Besides, a review co-matching layer is proposed to capture more semantic interactions between the reviews of the user and item.

u bert pre training user representations.subject: U-BERT
u bert pre training user representations.claim: Experiments on six benchmark datasets from different domains demonstrate the state-of-the-art performance of U-BERT.
u bert pre training user representations.quote: Experiments on six benchmark datasets from different domains demonstrate the state-of-the-art performance of U-BERT.

simcse simple contrastive learning of se.subject: SimCSE
simcse simple contrastive learning of se.claim: SimCSE is a simple contrastive learning framework that greatly advances the state-of-the-art sentence embeddings.
simcse simple contrastive learning of se.quote: This paper presents SimCSE, a simple contrastive learning framework that greatly advances the state-of-the-art sentence embeddings.

simcse simple contrastive learning of se.subject: SimCSE
simcse simple contrastive learning of se.claim: The unsupervised approach of SimCSE performs on par with previous supervised counterparts.
simcse simple contrastive learning of se.quote: This simple method works surprisingly well, performing on par with previous supervised counterparts.

simcse simple contrastive learning of se.subject: SimCSE

simcse simple contrastive learning of se.subject: SimCSE

simcse simple contrastive learning of se.subject: contrastive learning objective
simcse simple contrastive learning of se.claim: The contrastive learning objective regularizes pre-trained embeddings’ anisotropic space to be more uniform.
simcse simple contrastive learning of se.quote: We also show—both theoretically and empirically—that contrastive learning objective regularizes pre-trained embeddings’ anisotropic space to be more uniform, and it better aligns positive pairs when supervised signals are available.

empowering news recommendation with pre.subject: PLM-NR
empowering news recommendation with pre.claim: The paper reports work on pre-trained language models empowered news recommendation (PLM-NR).
empowering news recommendation with pre.quote: In this paper, we report our work on pre-trained language models empowered news recommendation (PLM-NR).

empowering news recommendation with pre.subject: PLM-NR
empowering news recommendation with pre.claim: Leveraging pre-trained language models for news modeling can effectively improve the performance of news recommendation.
empowering news recommendation with pre.quote: Offline experimental results on both monolingual and multilingual news recommendation datasets show that leveraging PLMs for news modeling can effectively improve the performance of news recommendation.

empowering news recommendation with pre.subject: PLM-NR
empowering news recommendation with pre.claim: The deployed PLM-NR models achieve significant performance gains in both English-speaking and global markets.
empowering news recommendation with pre.quote: Our PLM-NR models have been deployed to the Microsoft News platform, and online flight results show that they can achieve significant performance gains in both English-speaking and global markets.

empowering news recommendation with pre.subject: Existing news recommendation methods
empowering news recommendation with pre.claim: Existing news recommendation methods mainly model news texts based on traditional text modeling methods, which is not optimal for mining the deep semantic information in news texts.
empowering news recommendation with pre.quote: Existing news recommendation methods mainly model news texts based on traditional text modeling methods, which is not optimal for mining the deep semantic information in news texts.

k plug knowledge injected pre trained la.subject: K-PLUG
k plug knowledge injected pre trained la.claim: K-PLUG is a knowledge-injected pre-trained language model based on the encoder-decoder transformer that can be transferred to both natural language understanding and generation tasks.

k plug knowledge injected pre trained la.subject: K-PLUG
k plug knowledge injected pre trained la.claim: The method proposes five knowledge-aware self-supervised pre-training objectives to formulate the learning of domain-specific knowledge, including e-commerce domain-specific knowledge-bases, aspects of product entities, categories of product entities, and unique selling propositions of product entities.
